about: Zion, the Ark of God's law, is described as made in heaven and given to Moses on Sinai: the wood, the gold, the tablets, the manna and Aaron's rod within, carried across the Jordan and set in Judah, with the furnishings of the tent. The 318 fathers answer Amen, taking the Ark as the salvation of Adam's children and citing Psalms on Zion and the seed of David. Dematyos of Rome then says he found a book in the House of Sophia: the world is shared between the kings of Rome and of Ethiopia, both seed of Shem and sons of Solomon.

sentences.l: 17. Concerning her-glory, of-Zion.
sentences.i: Chapter 17: Concerning the Glory of Zion
sentences.n: Chapter heading. The numeral ፲ወ፯ is 10 and 7 = 17. በእንተ 'concerning' governs ክብራ, which is ክብር 'glory' with the suffix -ኣ 'her': the suffix anticipates the possessor named by the ለ- phrase, ለጽዮን 'of Zion', so the whole is 'her glory, Zion's' (the same pattern as ዕበያ ወክብራ ለጽዮን in ch. 1). It is not a construct state, and the -ra is not a feminine ending. Zion here is the Ark itself, as throughout the book.

sentences.i: As for Zion, the Ark of God's law: he first established her in heaven, and it pleased him that she should be on earth as the dwelling of his glory; of his own will he brought her down to the earth and gave it to Moses, that he might make her after the pattern;
sentences.n: ወለጽዮንሰ: ወ- 'and' + ለ- 'as for/to' + enclitic -ሰ (contrastive 'as for'). ታቦተ ሕጉ ለእግዚኣብሔር 'ark of his law, God's' stands in apposition to Zion (ሕጉ = ሕግ + -u 'his'; ለእግዚኣብሔር names the possessor). አቅዲሙ 'first, beforehand'. ሣረረ is uncertain: I cannot place the root with confidence (perhaps connected with ሥር 'root': 'made firm, established'); 'fashioned' is not supported by the form, so I read 'first established (her in) heaven', with ሰማየ an accusative of place. Another possible reading takes አቅዲሙ ሰማየ as 'before heaven' (she was fixed before the heavens), which would agree with ch. 1 (before all creation); I keep the first and flag the second. ሠምረ 'was pleased' governs ትኩን 'that she be' (3fs jussive of ኮነ). ፈቂዶ is a gerund of ፈቀደ (masc. sg. in -o): 'having willed, willingly'. አውረዳ 'he brought her down': causative አ- stem of ወረደ + -ኣ. ወወሀቦ: ወሀበ 'gave' + -ኦ, a masculine 'him/it' anticipating ለሙሴ; Zion is otherwise -ኣ 'her', so I read 'gave it, to Moses' and do not press the suffix. በአርአያ 'after the pattern': Exodus 25:9, 25:40; ይግበራ is 3ms jussive of ገብረ + -ኣ 'her' (Moses is the maker).

sentences.i: And he said to him: 'Make an ark of wood that does not rot, and overlay it with refined gold, and place in it the word of the law of the covenant, which I wrote with my fingers, that they may keep my law: the two tablets of the covenant.' And within her is one heavenly and spiritual, whose colour and make are strange: she resembles [ṭəlma], [wäkäy], [wärawre], [zäwhär], crystal, and light;
sentences.n: God speaks (ወይቤሎ 'and he said to him'). Imperatives and jussives: ግበር 'make' (imperative); ወትለብጦ and ወታነብር, 2ms imperfects used as commands ('and you shall overlay / place'): Exodus 25:10–11, 16 (the tablets), 31:18 (written 'with the finger of God'). ዘኢይነቅዝ 'which does not rot' (ዘ- relative + ኢ- negative). ንጡፍ: I render 'refined' (the sense 'pure, refined' is a guess). ዘኪዳን 'of the covenant' is a ዘ- genitive. God's speech ends with 'the two tablets of the covenant'; what follows is the narrator's description. ሰማያዊት መንፈሳዊት 'a heavenly, spiritual (one)' are feminine adjectives with no noun named, presumably the heavenly Ark within the earthly one; ሕብራ 'her colour' and ግብራ 'her making' take the singular ነኪር 'strange, foreign'. ትመስል 'she resembles' governs a list of words I cannot define: ጥልማ (perhaps 'darkness', cf. ጽልመት), ወከይ, ወራውሬ and ዘውሀር are rare or unknown to me, and are bracketed in the English; ብሉር is 'crystal' or 'beryl' (a loanword), ብርሃን 'light'. Treat these colour-words as uncertain.

sentences.l: Free(?) she and-dwelling-of divinity, which in-heavens dwelling-her and-on-earth she-walks-about and-with man she-dwells and-with angels fellow-citizen-of(?) man saviour(?), and-for-spirit holy dwelling, and-in-her-also gomor of-gold measured(?) manna which-descended from-heavens;
sentences.i: She is free, and the dwelling of the Godhead, whose dwelling is in the heavens, while on earth she walks about; she dwells with human beings and with the angels, a fellow-citizen of men and a saviour; she is a dwelling for the Holy Spirit; and within her, too, is a golden gomor measured out(?), of manna that came down from heaven;
sentences.n: Uncertain in places. አግዓዚት is the feminine of አግዓዚ, which means 'free (one)' and also 'liberator'; I read 'she is free' (the other sense is possible). ዘበሰማያት ማኅደራ 'whose dwelling is in the heavens' (ዘ- relative, the pronoun suffix on ማኅደራ resumes it). ታንሶሱ 'she walks about' (quadriliteral, 3fs). ተኀድር 'she dwells' (3fs imperfect of ኀደረ, cf. ማኅደር 'dwelling'). The phrase ሀገሪተ ሰብእ መድኀኒት is obscure: ሀገሪት suggests 'citizen/native' (from ሀገር 'city'), so I read 'a fellow-citizen of men, a saviour' (መድኀኒት as the feminine of መድኀኒ 'saviour'; it could be the noun 'salvation'), but the construction is uncertain. ለመንፈስ ቅዱስ ማኅደር 'a dwelling for the Holy Spirit'. ጎሞር is the omer-measure (Greek γομορ, Hebrew ʿōmer; Exodus 16:16–36), here of gold, and recalls the golden pot of manna of Hebrews 9:4; ስፉር I take as a passive participle of ሰፈረ 'to measure', 'measured out', which is uncertain. መና 'manna'; ዘወረደ እምሰማያት 'which came down from the heavens' (cf. John 6:31).

sentences.i: They carried it before the people until they brought it into the land of inheritance, which is Jerusalem, the city of Zion. And while they were crossing the Jordan, with the priests carrying it, the water stood like a wall(?) until all the people had crossed;
sentences.n: Joshua 3:14–17 (the priests with the ark stand in the Jordan, the water stands still). ወይጸውርዋ 'they carry her' (ጾረ + -ዋ); ያበውእዋ 'they bring her in' (causative of ቦአ + -ዋ); ምድረ ርስት 'land of inheritance' (constructs ምድረ, ሀገረ before their genitives). እንተ ይእቲ ኢየሩሳሌም 'which is Jerusalem': the fem. relative agrees with ምድረ. ወእንዘ 'and while'. ተዐዱ: the stem is ዐደወ, which with the ተ- prefix and an accusative (ዮርዳኖስ) is the ተዐደወ 'pass over' of ch. 9–12 and 13–16; the form is odd, since a 3mp perfect would be ተዐደዉ and after እንዘ I expect an imperfect (cf. የዐዱ below), so 'while they were crossing' is the sense, the parse uncertain. ከመ አረፍት: I take አረፍት as 'wall', which is uncertain. የዐዱ 'they cross' (3mp jussive) after እስከ 'until'.

sentences.l: and-after they-crossed all people crossed priests they-carrying ark, and-they-placed-her in city-of Judah land-of inheritance, and-were-filled(?) prophets in tent-of testimony upon-them for-sons-of Israel, and-priests-also they-carry ephod that they-serve for-tent-of meeting(?), and-chiefs-of priests-also they-offer offering that they-atone for sins-their and-then for sin-of people.
sentences.i: And after all the people had crossed, the priests crossed over carrying the Ark, and they set it in the city of Judah, the land of inheritance. And prophets were filled(?) in the tent of testimony, over the children of Israel; and the priests carried the ephod to serve the tent of meeting(?); and the chief priests offered sacrifice to make atonement, first for their own sins and then for the sin of the people.
sentences.n: A summary of Israel's settlement and of Leviticus 16 (the high priest atones for himself, then for the people; cf. Hebrews 9:7). Verbs: ዐደዉ 3mp perfect 'they crossed'; ጸዊሮሙ 'carrying' is a gerund of ጾረ, in which -ሙ is the 3mp subject ending ('they carrying'), not an object; አንበርዋ 'they placed her' (causative of ነበረ + -ዋ). ወተመልአኩ ነቢያት is uncertain: I read ተመልአኩ as the passive of መልአ 'to fill', 'the prophets were filled (with the Spirit)', but neither the verb nor the clause is secure. The ending also does not fit: a 3mp perfect of መልአ would be ተመልኡ, and -አኩ suggests a verb ending in -ከ, perhaps a denominal verb from መልአክ 'messenger' (መልአከ 'serve, send'), so 'were filled' is only the best guess. ኤፉደ 'ephod' (Exodus 28). ከመ ይትለአኩ 'that they serve' (ተለአከ 'minister, serve', 3mp jussive). መርጡል after ደብተራ is a word I cannot identify; 'meeting' is a guess from the sense. ሊቃነ ካህናት 'chiefs of priests' (plural construct of ሊቅ). ያስተስርዩ 'they atone' (causative reflexive of ሰረየ 'forgive'). እምዝ 'then, thereafter'.

sentences.i: Vessels of gold: dishes(?) and cups, [kʷäsakʷäsat] and tables, [śäqaśqat] and capitals of pillars, lamps and pitchers(?), [mäḫatwä] and [mäsawrä märanat], and tongs(?), [ʾäʿyagä] and [ʾäbḥərtä], brocades(?) and garments, crowns and [ʾäkmimatä], [därkäno] and [məṣiṣitä bəsaṭatä], and the colour of liver, the perfume for the anointing of priesthood and kingship, and hyacinth, and [melatä nätä] (purple?), twisted thread and fine linen, goats' hair, and rams' skins, dyed(?), and the stone of sardius, carbuncle(?), sapphire and emerald; in the tent of testimony, where Zion, the dwelling of his glory, dwells. And they shall make for her a hollow vessel (literally 'belly of a boat'), with the two tablets that were written by the fingers of God; and Zion shall dwell upon them;
sentences.n: This list draws on Exodus 25:3–7, 25:23–39, 28:17–20 and 30:23–25 (materials and furnishings of the tent; the breastplate stones; the anointing oil). Most items are rare words or loanwords and they could not be checked against a lexicon here, so the English separates three grades. Secure or nearly so: ጽዋዓተ 'cups', ጥርጴዛተ 'tables' (Greek trapeza), ቀናዲለ 'lamps' (Greek kandela), አርእስተ አዕማዳት 'capitals of pillars', አልባሰ 'garments', አክሊላተ 'crowns', ዕፍረተ ዘቅብአ ክህነት ወመንግሥት 'perfume of the anointing of priesthood and kingship', ያክንተ 'hyacinth, blue', ክዑበ 'twisted', ቡሱስ 'byssus, fine linen', ጸጐረ ጠሊ 'goats' hair', ሰንፔር 'sapphire', መረግድ 'emerald', ሰርድዮን 'sardius'; ሕብረ ከብድ is literally 'colour of liver' (which colour or thing I do not know). Guessed, marked (?) in the English: ጸሀራተ 'dishes' (it looks like a variant of ጻሕል 'dish'); መሳቅየ 'pitchers' (a መ- noun from ሰቀየ 'give to drink'); መማሥጠ 'tongs' (from ማሥጠ 'snatch', cf. Exodus 25:38); ዲባጋተ 'brocades' (as in ch. 13–16); ሕሱይ 'dyed'; ከርከዴን 'carbuncle' (Greek karchēdōn; the draft's 'carnelian' had no support); ሜላተ ነተ 'purple' (by position in the Exodus 25:4 sequence: blue, purple, scarlet, linen). Not translated, given in brackets as transliterations (the bracket means 'a word I cannot translate', not a gap in the text): ኰሳኰሳተ, ሠቃሥቃተ, መኃትወ, መሳውረ መራናተ, አዕያገ, አብሕርተ, አክሚማተ, ደርከኖ, ምጺጺተ ብሳጣተ, ነተ. The English no longer gives a confident word for any of these. ከርሠ ሐመር 'belly of a boat' I read as a hollow chest or hold of the Ark (the referent is uncertain). The unit has 67 words and no ፤ inside it to cut at. ጽሑፋን 'written' is the masculine plural (-ān) passive participle of ጸሐፈ, agreeing with ጽላት 'tablets'.

sentences.i: And you shall make its fittings(?) and its latches(?) of pure gold, and mouldings(?) round about; and in its four supports(?) (corners or feet) you shall make four rings, its carrying-places(?); and you shall make [poles] of wood that does not rot and overlay them with refined gold, and with them you shall carry the Ark of the Law.
sentences.n: Exodus 25:11–15 (gold moulding, four rings, poles to carry). All the fitting-names are guesses: መዓብል and መቃፍል ('fittings, latches', cf. ቀፈለ 'enclose'), ኆጻዳት 'mouldings, rims', መሳምክት 'supports' (from ሰምከ 'lean', perhaps the feet or corners), ከበሎ 'rings' (the usual Geʿez word for rings, not checked), መሳክም 'carrying-places' (cf. 'shoulder'). The object of ወትገብር እምነ ዕፅ... is not stated; I supply 'poles' from Exodus 25:13 and bracket it in the English. ቦቱ 'with it/by it' (the poles). ትጸውርዋ 'you (pl.) carry her' (ትጸውሩ + -ኣ); ለታቦተ ሕግ marks the object (apposition to -ዋ). The unit's end ፨ is a section mark.

sentences.n: Exodus 25:9, 40; 24:16 (Sinai). ከመዝ 'thus'. አርአዮ 'he showed him' (causative of ርእየ + -ኦ). ግብራ ወሥርዐታ ወሕብራ ለደብተራ: the three suffixes -ኣ all anticipate the possessor named by ለደብተራ, so 'the tent's making, order and form'. ከብረት and ዐብየት: 3fs perfects 'she was glorified', 'she became great'; the subject is not stated (the tent, or Zion, 'the dwelling of his glory'), and I leave 'she'. በደብረ ሲና: 'on Mount Sinai' (construct ደብረ). ተአምነት is uncertain: it can mean faith, trust, confidence; the clause is probably 'and with God (there was) credence/trust in the dwelling of his glory'. Read cautiously.

sentences.l: And-from-half-her of-Jerusalem from-south-her until Mäsʿ(?) and-India western(?) share-his for-king-of Ethiopia, for both-of-them seed-of Shem son-of Noah, seed-of Abraham, seed-of David, sons-of Solomon they;
sentences.i: And from the middle of Jerusalem, from its south as far as Mäsʿ and India, the western share belongs to the king of Ethiopia; for both of them are the seed of Shem, son of Noah, the seed of Abraham, the seed of David, the sons of Solomon;
sentences.n: The first half repeats the previous unit almost word for word, with 'from the south' again: the repetition looks odd (one would expect a different direction), but I have not changed the text. ዐረባዊ: I take 'western' (from ዐረበ 'set, as the sun', paired with ሠረቃዊ 'eastern' from ሠረቀ 'rise' in the previous unit; the east/west pair is the natural one). It could instead be 'Arabian'; but the name of Arabia is usually written with the long vowel (ዓረብ), and this word has ዐ, so I keep 'western' and flag it. ወህንድ 'and India'. ክልኤሆሙ 'both of them' (ክልኤቱ + -ሙ) is the subject of the nominal clause ending እሙንቱ 'they are'. A chain of constructs: ዘርአ ሴም ወልደ ኖሕ 'seed of Shem, son of Noah'; ደቂቀ ሰሎሞን 'sons of Solomon'. Genesis 10, 12, 2 Samuel 7. The list says that the two kings are brothers by descent, a claim of the Kebra Nagast.

sentences.i: For God gave them glory, to the seed of Shem, because of the blessing of their father Noah. The king of Rome too is a son of Solomon; and the king of Ethiopia is a son of Solomon, his firstborn, who grows greater. . . .
sentences.n: Genesis 9:26–27 (Noah's blessing of Shem). ወሀቦሙ 'he gave them' (ወሀበ + -ሙ); ክብረ 'glory' is the object, and ለዘርአ ሴም 'to the seed of Shem' is in apposition. በእንተ በረከተ አቡሆሙ ኖሕ 'on account of the blessing of their father Noah' (construct chain). ንጉሠ ሮምሂ 'the king of Rome also' (-ሂ 'also'). ወልደ ሰሎሞን ውእቱ 'he is a son of Solomon' (ውእቱ the copula). በኰሩ 'his firstborn' (በኵር + -u). ዘይልህቅ 'who grows' (ልህቀ 'grow up, be great'): The English keeps 'who grows greater' (the form); 'who is the elder' is possible, and it is not certain whether it is said of the firstborn or the king. The ፨ ፨ closes chapter 20.

glossary.ወመሳቅየ: መስቀይ — and pitchers (?) (ወ- + plural መሳቅይ, accusative; from ሰቀየ 'give drink'; uncertain)
glossary.ወመሳውረ: መሳውር — and an implement (ወ- + noun; unidentified, uncertain)

glossary.ወሜላተ: ሜላ — and (a dyed stuff) (ወ- + noun, accusative; unidentified, uncertain, perhaps purple)

glossary.ወተሀይድ: ተሀይድ — and she dazzles (?) (ወ- + 3fs imperfect of a verb not identified; the sense is guessed from the context; uncertain)

glossary.ወትነብር: ነበረ — and she sits, dwells (ወ- + 3fs imperfect)
glossary.ወትከብት: ትከብት — and she is weighty (?) or honoured (?) (ወ- + 3fs imperfect of a verb not identified, perhaps related to ክብር or ከብደ; uncertain)
glossary.ወትገብር: ገብረ — and you shall make (ወ- + 2ms imperfect)
glossary.ወኆጻዳትኒ: ኆጻድ — and borders, mouldings also (ወ- + noun, plural ኆጻዳት + -ኒ; uncertain)
glossary.ወንጉሠ: ንጉሥ — and king of (ወ- + noun, construct)
glossary.ወአልባሰ: ልብስ — and garments (ወ- + plural አልባስ, accusative)
glossary.ወአርአዮ: አርአየ — and he showed him (ወ- + causative 3ms perfect of ርእየ + -ኦ 'him')
glossary.ወአርእስተ: ርእስ — and heads, capitals of (ወ- + plural አርእስት, construct)
glossary.ወአብሕርተ: አብሕርት — and (an unidentified vessel or utensil) (ወ- + noun, plural accusative; unidentified, uncertain)
glossary.ወአንበርዋ: አነበረ — and they placed her (ወ- + causative 3mp perfect of ነበረ + -ዋ 'her')
glossary.ወአክሚማተ: አክሚማት — and (an unidentified item) (ወ- + noun, plural accusative; unidentified, uncertain)

glossary.ወእባርኮሙ: ባረከ — and I will bless them (ወ- + 1cs imperfect + -ሙ 'them')
glossary.ወእብነ: እብን — and stone of (ወ- + noun, construct)
glossary.ወከርከዴን: ከርከዴን — and carbuncle (?) (ወ- + noun; gem, Greek loan; uncertain)

glossary.ወካህናትኒ: ካህን — and the priests also (ወ- + plural ካህናት + enclitic -ኒ)

glossary.ወዘሰንፔር: ሰንፔር — and of sapphire (ወ- + ዘ- 'of' + noun; Greek loan)
glossary.ወዘውሀር: ዘውሀር — uncertain: perhaps 'jewel' (cf. Arabic jawhar) (ወ- 'and' + noun)
glossary.ወያክንተ: ያክንት — and hyacinth, blue (ወ- + noun, accusative; Greek loan)
glossary.ወያድኅኖሙ: አድኀነ — and he saves them (ወ- + 3ms imperfect + -ሙ 'them')
glossary.ወይሖሩ: ሖረ — and they walk, go (ወ- + 3mp jussive)

glossary.ወጸላእቱኒ: ጸላኢ — and his enemies also (ወ- + plural ጸላእት + -ሁ 'his' + enclitic -ኒ)

glossary.ዘይሠራዕ: ሠርዐ — which is set up, ordained (ዘ- relative + 3ms imperfect, passive sense)
glossary.ዘይከውን: ኮነ — who will be (ዘ- relative + 3ms imperfect)
glossary.ዘጸሐፍኩ: ጸሐፈ — which I wrote (ዘ- relative + 1cs perfect)
glossary.የብሰት: የብሰ — she was dry, withered (3fs perfect, y-b-s)

glossary.ይትለአኩ: ተለአከ — that they serve, minister (3mp jussive of ተለአከ, the ተ- stem of ለአከ)
glossary.ይዕቀቡ: ዐቀበ — that they keep (3mp jussive, ʿ-q-b)
glossary.ይገብኡ: ገብአ — they return, submit (3mp imperfect, g-b-ʾ)
glossary.ይግበራ: ገብረ — that he make her (3ms jussive + -ኣ 'her')
glossary.ደርከኖ: ደርከኖ — uncertain, unidentified (a furnishing or garment)
glossary.ደቂቀ: ደቂቅ — sons, children (plural ደቂቅ, construct 'sons of')
glossary.ዲባጋተ: ዲባግ — brocade, fine garment (noun, plural accusative; uncertain)
glossary.ድማትዮስ: ድማትዮስ — Dəmatyos (proper name; not identified with Demetrius, whose Geʿez form would be ድሜጥሮስ)

glossary.ጥልማ: ጥልማ — uncertain, unidentified; perhaps 'darkness' (cf. ጽልመት); the object of ትመስል (noun; the final -ኣ is not an accusative ending)
glossary.ጸሀራተ: ጸሀር — dish (?) (noun, plural ጸሀራት, accusative; unidentified, perhaps related to ጻሕል 'dish'; uncertain)
glossary.ጸገየት: ጸገየ — she budded, blossomed (3fs perfect, ṣ-g-y)
glossary.ጽላተ: ጽላት — tablets of (noun, plural; construct before ዘኪዳን)

glossary.ጽሩይ: ጽሩይ — pure, refined (adjective, passive participle of ጸረየ)
glossary.ፈቂዶ: ፈቀደ — willingly, of his own will (gerund of ፈቀደ 'wish, will', f-q-d, used adverbially)
glossary.ፈጠራ: ፈጠረ — he created her (3ms perfect, G, f-ṭ-r; + -ኣ 'her')

glossary.፲ወ፰: ፲ወ፰ — 18, spoken ዐሠርቱ ወሰመንቱ (ʿäśärtu wä-sämäntu) 'ten and eight'; chapter number (numeral)
glossary.፲፱: ፲፱ — 19, spoken ዐሠርቱ ወትስዐቱ (ʿäśärtu wä-təsʿätu) 'ten and nine'; chapter number (numeral)
